title: narcissus minor var. brevicoronatus
intro: Narcissus minor var. brevicoronatus, commonly known as the dwarf narcissus or miniature daffodil, is a variety of the Narcissus minor plant, which belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, which can aid in reducing fever, relieving pain, and protecting against various infections. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus minor var. brevicoronatus include its potential use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its possible application in treating gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids like galantamine and homocholine, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
